description.sl: Kmetija mlinarja Franca: krava in tele, koza in oven, prašič in svinjak, osel in mula, gos, petelin in piščanček, kurnik, ograda in pašnik, jasli, molsti, volna, slama in plug.
description.en: Mugnaio Franco's farm: the cow and the calf, the goat and the ram, the pig and the pigsty, the donkey and the mule, the goose, the cockerel and the chick, the henhouse, the pen and the pasture, the manger, milking, wool, straw and the plough.
description.de: Der Hof von Mugnaio Franco: Kuh und Kalb, Ziege und Widder, Schwein und Schweinestall, Esel und Maultier, die Gans, der Hahn und das Küken, der Hühnerstall, Gehege und Weide, die Futterkrippe, melken, Wolle, Stroh und Pflug.

review: it, sl, en, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker
